architecture_decisions: Preserve the existing QA-user authorization boundary while admitting only explicitly enumerated GitHub Actions workflow identities for machine QA.
Use a QA-owned canonical Engineering Run for W8-S2 verification rather than granting cross-owner access to the historical OT Time run.
work_items: Admit the isolated W8-S2 QA workflow ref under the existing GitHub Actions OIDC verifier.
Replay the QA-owned canonical PLAN run through normal protected production APIs and verify durable advancement without the former static-target failure.
validations: AC-01: validate protected requirement — A GitHub-signed OIDC token is accepted only when issuer, audience, repository, main ref, an explicitly enumerated QA workflow ref, an explicitly allowed bounded event, and GitHub-hosted runner claims all match.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — The API issues a session only when `parallax.qa.ai@gmail.com` exists in `authorized_users`, is active, and already has a bound Google auth user ID.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Neither repository code nor workflow configuration stores the QA password, refresh token, Supabase service-role key, Parallax access token, or another long-lived QA credential.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Google login, hidden human QA password fallback, session expiry, logout, owner/member access, Project ownership isolation and protected-route behavior remain unchanged; the machine-authenticated QA member cannot read or mutate the historical owner-scoped OT Time run.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Before replay, Engineering Run `a3a32343-507a-4384-a9bd-2fddaa0ce7fc` is QA-owned, at PLAN revision 1, bound through an approved Work Specification to a valid GitHub repository, and the Vercel team has no Project linked to `Ryan9876/sickbeard`.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — The isolated W8-S2 workflow establishes a production Parallax session and invokes the existing protected autonomous endpoint for the admitted QA-owned canonical run without owner browser interaction, auth bypass, direct database mutation, or owner impersonation.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — The replay passes only if durable run evidence advances beyond the former missing-static-target PLAN failure without `source_bootstrap_failed` / `ProductionDeliveryConfigurationError`; provider/runtime evidence stays within the existing Preview/REVIEW authority ceiling.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Forged, malformed, expired, not-yet-valid, wrong-audience, wrong-repository, wrong-ref, non-enumerated-workflow, unapproved-event, self-hosted-runner and JWKS-verification failures produce no Parallax session; a missing, inactive, revoked or no-longer-Google-bound QA row also produces no session.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — The GitHub workflow run provides durable provider-side run identity and bounded execution evidence while raw OIDC tokens, cookies, passwords, refresh tokens and provider credentials remain absent from committed artifacts and application logs.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The exact qualified source is merged and deployed READY before replay; ordinary Google and hidden human QA behavior remain unchanged; post-replay GitHub workflow evidence, Vercel runtime evidence, durable Engineering Run state and provider readiness state are inspected before any W8-S2 completion claim or authoritative-record update.
risks: Workflow trust expansion must remain an explicit finite allowlist and must not broaden QA authority beyond its own Projects and Runs.
The canonical fixture is valid only while its pre-replay state retains the material W8-S2 defect preconditions.
